situation: My college friend Mia invited me to her bachelorette in Tulum, about $1,800 all in. Can't afford it and honestly we're not that close anymore. Want to message her directly, not the group chat.
reply: Thank you for including me, Mia, it sounds like an amazing trip. I can't make Tulum this time. I'll be cheering from here, and I can't wait to celebrate with you at the wedding in May.
note: No reason given: 'can't afford it' invites a discount offer, and no alternative is proposed because you wouldn't go on another date either.

situation: 部门老大刘总周五晚上请大家吃饭唱K，我那天要去机场接出差回来的老公，而且本来也不太想去。想私聊跟他说一声。
reply: 谢谢刘总请客！周五晚上我要去机场接人，这次就不去了，祝大家玩得开心。下次部门活动算我一个。
note: 一个真实、简短的理由就够了，不用解释自己本来也不太想去。

situation: Told my aunt I can't come to Thanksgiving this year because we're doing it with my husband's family. She replied 'it won't be the same without you, can't you at least come for dessert?'
reply: I really can't this year, Aunt Carol, and I'll miss your pecan pie. Can I call you that afternoon and say hi to everyone?
note: When they push, repeat the no once and add no new reasons; new reasons are new things to negotiate.
